life_summary: Ronald Anderson Rasband was born on February 6, 1951, in Salt Lake City, Utah. He grew up in Utah's capital and pursued a business career that spanned multiple sectors and industries. Before dedicating himself to full-time Church service, Rasband established himself as a successful entrepreneur and business leader, bringing practical experience in commerce and organizational management. In 1973, he married Melanie Twitchell, and together they raised five children while managing a busy professional life. His business background provided him with administrative expertise and an understanding of organizational dynamics that would later inform his Church leadership responsibilities.
church_summary: Rasband served as a missionary in the Eastern States Mission, covering the New York Metro area, western New York, and Pennsylvania during his early adult years. He was called to the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles in 2015 and served as an Area President responsible for the Europe Central Area. During his area assignment, he oversaw the construction of the first chapel the Church built in the Czech Republic, demonstrating his commitment to expanding the Church's physical presence in formerly restricted regions. His ministry has focused on administrative excellence and the practical implementation of Church programs and initiatives across diverse geographic and cultural contexts.
